lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhau khaanaa peenaa sukh saar ||
lines.translation: Those who eat and drink the Fear of God, find the most excellent peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan sa(n)gat paavai paar ||
lines.translation: Associating with the humble servants of the Lord, they are carried across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach bolai bolaavai piaar ||
lines.translation: They speak the Truth, and lovingly inspire others to speak it as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad karanee hai saar ||7||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the most excellent occupation. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jas karam dharam pat poojaa ||
lines.translation: Those who take the Lord's Praises as their karma and Dharma, their honor and worship service

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਭੂੰਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh aganee mahi bhoo(n)jaa ||
lines.translation: their sexual desire and anger are burnt off in the fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras chaakhiaa tau man bheejaa ||
lines.translation: They taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and their minds are drenched with it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੮॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: pranavat naanak avar na doojaa ||8||5||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, there is no other at all. ||8||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap a(n)tar poojaa ||
lines.translation: Chant the Lord's Name, and worship Him deep within your being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabad veechaar avar nahee doojaa ||1||
lines.translation: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and no other. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko rav rahiaa sabh thaaee ||
lines.translation: The One is pervading all places.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar na deesai kis pooj chaRaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I do not see any other; unto whom should I offer worship? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਤੁਝ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan aagai jeeaRaa tujh paas ||
lines.translation: I place my mind and body in offering before You; I dedicate my soul to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakhahu aradaas ||2||
lines.translation: As it pleases You, You save me, Lord; this is my prayer. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach jihavaa har rasan rasaaee ||
lines.translation: True is that tongue which is delighted by the sublime essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramat chhootas prabh saranaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, one is saved in the Sanctuary of God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam dharam prabh merai keee ||
lines.translation: My God created religious rituals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਕੀਏ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naam vadaaee sir karamaa(n) keee ||4||
lines.translation: He placed the glory of the Naam above these rituals. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kai vas chaar padaarath ||
lines.translation: The four great blessings are under the control of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਰਥ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: teen samaae ek kritaarath ||5||
lines.translation: When the first three are put aside, one is blessed with the fourth. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਏ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਧਿਆਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur deee mukat dhiaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Those whom the True Guru blesses with liberation and meditation

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ ਭਏ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: har pad cheenhi bhae paradhaanaa ||6||
lines.translation: realize the Lord's State, and become sublime. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan seetal gur boojh bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: Their minds and bodies are cooled and soothed; the Guru imparts this understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: prabh nivaaje kin keemat paaee ||7||
lines.translation: Who can estimate the value of those whom God has exalted? ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak gur boojh bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has imparted this understanding;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa gat kinai na paaee ||8||6||
lines.translation: without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is emancipated. ||8||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik dhur bakhas lae gur poorai sachee banat banaaee ||
lines.translation: Some are forgiven by the Primal Lord God; the Perfect Guru makes the true making.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har ra(n)g raate sadaa ra(n)g saachaa dukh bisare pat paaee ||1||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord are imbued with Truth forever; their pains are dispelled, and they obtain honor. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothee duramat kee chaturaaee ||
lines.translation: False are the clever tricks of the evil-minded.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: binasat baar na laagai kaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: They shall disappear in no time at all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਵਿਆਪਸਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh kau dukh darad viaapas manamukh dukh na jaaee ||
lines.translation: Pain and suffering afflict the self-willed manmukh. The pains of the self-willed manmukh shall never depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sukh dukh daataa guramukh jaataa mel lae saranaaee ||2||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh recognizes the Giver of pleasure and pain. He merges in His Sanctuary. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਅਭ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਸਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚਹਿ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh te abh bhagat na hovas haumai pachahi divaane ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know loving devotional worship; they are insane, rotting away in their egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭਿ ਪਇਆਲੀ ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ihu manooaa khin oobh paiaalee jab lag sabad na jaane ||3||
lines.translation: This mind flies in an instant from the heavens to the underworld, as long as it does not know the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਜਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhookh piaasaa jag bhaiaa tipat nahee bin satigur paae ||
lines.translation: The world has become hungry and thirsty; without the True Guru, it is not satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sahajai sahaj milai sukh paaeeai daragah paidhaa jaae ||4||
lines.translation: Merging intuitively in the Celestial Lord, peace is obtained, and one goes to the Lord's Court wearing robes of honor. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: daragah daanaa beenaa ik aape niramal gur kee baanee ||
lines.translation: The Lord in His Court is Himself the Knower and Seer; the Word of the Guru's Bani is Immaculate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aape surataa sach veechaaras aape boojhai pad nirabaanee ||5||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Awareness of Truth; He Himself understands the state of nirvaanaa. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲੁ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਵਨੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal tara(n)g aganee pavanai phun trai mil jagat upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He made the waves of water, the fire and the air, and then joined the three together to form the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਬਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa bal chhal tin kau deeaa hukamee thaak rahaaiaa ||6||
lines.translation: He blessed these elements with such power, that they remain subject to His Command. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aise jan virale jag a(n)dar parakh khajaanai paaiaa ||
lines.translation: How rare are those humble beings in this world, whom the Lord tests and places in His Treasury.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jaat varan te bhae ateetaa mamataa lobh chukaaiaa ||7||
lines.translation: They rise above social status and color, and rid themselves of possessiveness and greed. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam rate teerath se niramal dukh haumai mail chukaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are like immaculate sacred shrines; they are rid of the pain and pollution of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin ke charan pakhaalai jinaa guramukh saachaa bhaaiaa ||8||7||
lines.translation: Nanak washes the feet of those who, as Gurmukh, love the True Lord. ||8||7||
